title: 第14章  你们若是不能杀死我，就要被我杀死
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
陆渊推开大门，径直朝着院内走去。
他眸光颤动，在夜色中泛着金芒，心中战意升腾。
如渊似海的灵力在经脉中急剧压缩，凝聚为澄澈灵晶，将所有气息收敛在内，不泄露一丝一毫。
陆渊此行是为杀妖而来。
在他的视线中，陈家宅院内妖气冲天而起，少说也有七八十只妖魔。
万一里面那些妖魔被他的气息所震慑，提前溜了，那这趟就亏大了。
来时他遇到了撤退的苏定安，根据对方所说，里面大多数妖魔都是初境气息。
面对如此阵容，吴守信一个镇魔卫根本撑不了多久。
但对陆渊来说，这根本不算什么。
即便他不知道血妖的谋划，甚至都不知道那只血妖藏在哪里。
但无所谓，他只是来杀妖的。
院墙轰然爆开，碎砖飞溅，一道人影裹挟着烟尘中踏入庭院。
一众血奴纷纷扭头看来，灰白的眼珠盯着那道身影，连对吴守信的攻势都慢了几分。
陈连山也被吓了一跳，脸上的笑容变得僵硬。
看着那道身影一步步走出烟尘，他猩红的瞳孔骤然收缩。
“大人！”
看清来人后，浑身是血的吴守信大喜过望。
他靠在墙角，身上伤口不断淌血，连站都站不稳，正用一种难以置信的眼神看着陆渊。
他想过很多种可能，却唯独没想过救场的人会是陆渊。
陈连山神情微怔，脸色瞬间变得凝重。

“镇魔司的人？他不应该在北渡口吗？”
奇怪了！
血妖大人命那些水伥牵制镇魔司的人，短时间内绝对不可能脱身，怎么会有镇魔卫来此？
不过还好，宅子周边并没有其它气息，应该是独自前来。
想到这里，他脸色恢复镇定，嘴角勾起笑容。
“又是一个镇魔卫？出场挺不错，可惜太蠢了。”
他负手而立，看向陆渊的眼神就像是在看一个懵懂小辈。
“这座院子可是血妖大人的布置，你一个人闯进来又能做什么？”
“这里有四十只初境血奴，就算你是初境，又能撑多久？一炷香？还是两炷香？”
话音落下，所有的初境血奴齐刷刷将陆渊围了起来。
一双双灰白色的眼珠盯着他，森寒杀意几乎要凝成实质。
吴守信靠在墙角面露绝望，拼尽最后力气喊了一声：
“大人，撤！！！”
陆渊充耳不闻，目光扫视四周，轻笑出声：“八十七。”
陈连山一脸疑惑，“什么意思？”
陆渊眼瞳闪过淡淡金光，“宅子里总共有八十七只血奴。”
“然后呢？”
“然后，我想说，也别藏着掖着了，你们全都一起上吧。”
“......”
陈连山眉头微微皱起，“你这话什么意思？”

“没什么意思，别误会。”
陆渊缓缓抬手，经脉之内的灵晶汹涌咆哮，绽放出前所未有的璀璨光辉。
“今天你们若是不能杀死我，就要被我杀死。”
话音落下的瞬间，灵力化晶，两道三尺长的锋棱晶刺出现在他手中。
“这是......”
陈连山瞳孔骤缩。
被转化为血奴之前，他也是赤霞县陈家的掌舵者，眼界自然是非同寻常。
灵力化晶，这是将灵力淬炼到极致的手段。
寻常武者根本做不到，就算能做到也需要长时间蓄力。
可对方只是谈笑间就成了。
这手段，怎么看都不像初境武者。
他脸色微变，本能地感到有些不妙。
“等等......”
就在他开口的瞬间，一道晶刺疾射而出，在夜色中划过一抹微亮光痕。
当先的那个血奴身躯一颤，瞬间被射穿头颅，脑袋直接爆开。
晶刺去势不减，接连击杀了后面三只血奴，随后刺入院墙。
【击杀凡境血奴，获得白色词条[嗜血]×4】
瞬息之间，院墙被刺穿一个小臂粗的孔洞，一众血奴这才反应过来，惊骇地向后退去。
陈连山也是看得眼皮狂跳。
他怎么也没想到，那晶刺竟然拥有如此恐怖的杀伤力。

若是再这么继续下去......
陈连山下意识看向宅院深处，只一眼，他心中便像是做出了某种决断。
“别以为你杀了几只凡境血奴我就拿你没办法！”
他吞下一枚血色丹药，一抹妖异血光突然从眼底迸发。
紧接着，他浑身青筋暴起，骨骼发出噼里啪啦的爆响。
狂暴的血腥气息扑面袭来，夹杂着暴虐与杀机。
“你以为你赢了？”
陈连山狞笑着，周身弥漫出惊人血光，气息瞬间暴涨至初境。
他探手抓向后背，一柄通体血红的骨刀从背脊抽出，带着撕裂空气的尖啸劈向陆渊。
周围的血奴似是受到鼓舞，双眼变得一片血红，恶鬼般扑杀上去。
陆渊眼瞳迸发金光，在吴守信眼中快若闪电的刀招突然变得缓慢下来。
就在刀锋落下的瞬间，他脚下微微一错，血色刀光擦肩劈空，连一根发丝都没伤到。
陆渊甩手，三尺晶刺倏地疾射而出。
晶刺如矛，瞬间刺穿陈连山胸膛，在地上炸开一个深坑，将他钉在其中。
陈连山咳出一口鲜血，四肢抽搐了几下，彻底不动了。
烟尘散去。
墙角的吴守信艰难地动了动喉结，惊骇不已。
吃了血丹后，陈连山的修为可是暴涨至初境啊！
就这么被解决了？
在册三年，他不止一次见过镇魔校尉的战斗，可从没一人能像陆渊这么强大。

这是在斩杀妖魔吗？
感觉和杀鸡屠狗差不了多少。
四周的血奴浑身颤抖，原本的杀意在瞬间化作深深地恐惧。
陈连山可是血奴的头领，而且还吃了血妖大人赐下的血丹，一身修为直逼初境后期，竟然连一招都撑不过？
这还怎么打？
站在最前的几只血奴彻底吓傻了，双腿发软，连跑都不敢跑。
“哈哈......哈哈哈......”阴恻恻的笑声突然响起。
深坑之中，被晶刺穿胸的陈连山猛地抬头，露出一对血红眸子。
“灵力化晶，杀伤力果然惊人！”
“可你如此剧烈地消耗灵力，就算是初境武者也坚持不了多久吧？”
content_en:
Lu Yuan pushed open the door and walked straight into the courtyard.
His eyes trembled, glowing golden in the night, and fighting spirit rose in his heart.
The spiritual power as deep as the sea compressed rapidly in the meridians and condensed into clear spiritual crystals, which contained all the breath without leaking even a trace.
Lu Yuan came here to kill demons.
In his sight, the demonic aura soared into the sky in the Chen family residence. There were at least seventy or eighty demons.
If the demons inside were frightened by his aura and escaped early, then this trip would be a huge loss.
When he came, he met Su Ding'an who was retreating. According to what he said, most of the demons inside were the auras of the first realm.
Facing such a lineup, Wu Shouxin could not last long as a demon-suppressing guard.
But to Lu Yuan, this was nothing.
Even if he didn't know the blood demon's plan, he didn't even know where the blood demon was hiding.
But it doesn't matter, he's just here to kill monsters.
The courtyard wall exploded with a bang, broken bricks flying, and a figure stepped into the courtyard wrapped in smoke and dust.
All the blood slaves turned their heads to look, their gray eyes staring at that figure, even their attack on Wu Shouxin was a little slower.
Chen Lianshan was also startled, and the smile on his face became stiff.
Watching the figure walking out of the smoke step by step, his scarlet pupils suddenly shrank.
"My lord!"
After seeing the person clearly, Wu Shouxin, who was covered in blood, was overjoyed.
He was leaning against the corner, bleeding from the wounds on his body, unable to even stand still, and looking at Lu Yuan with disbelief.
He thought about many possibilities, but he never thought that Lu Yuan would be the one to save the situation.
Chen Lianshan looked slightly startled, and his face instantly became solemn.
"A man from the Demon Suppression Division? Shouldn't he be at Beidukou?"
Strange!
Lord Blood Demon ordered those minions to contain the Demon Suppressing Division. It would be absolutely impossible for them to escape in a short time. Why would the Demon Suppressing Guard come here?
Fortunately, there was no other smell around the house, so he probably came alone.
Thinking of this, his face returned to calmness and a smile appeared on his lips.
"Another demon-suppressing guard? It's a good appearance, but it's too stupid."
He stood with his hands behind his hands and looked at Lu Yuan as if he were looking at an ignorant junior.
"This courtyard is arranged by Lord Blood Demon. What can you do if you break in alone?"
"There are forty first-level blood slaves here. Even if you are the first-level blood slave, how long can you last? One stick of incense? Or two sticks of incense?"
As soon as he finished speaking, all the first-level blood slaves surrounded Lu Yuan.
A pair of gray-white eyes stared at him, and Senhan's murderous intent almost solidified.
Wu Shouxin leaned against the wall with a desperate look on his face, and yelled with all his last strength:
"Sir, withdraw!!!"
Lu Yuan turned a deaf ear, glanced around, and chuckled: "Eighty-seven."
Chen Lianshan looked confused, "What do you mean?"
Lu Yuan's eyes flashed with a faint golden light, "There are a total of eighty-seven blood slaves in the house."
"Then what?"
"Then, I want to say, don't hide it, you all come together."
"..."
Chen Lianshan frowned slightly, "What do you mean by this?"
"It's not interesting, don't get me wrong."
Lu Yuan slowly raised his hand, and the spiritual crystals in his meridians surged and roared, blooming with unprecedented brilliance.
"If you can't kill me today, you will be killed by me."
The moment he finished speaking, his spiritual power crystallized, and two three-foot-long sharp crystal thorns appeared in his hands.
"This is..."
Chen Lianshan's pupils shrank suddenly.
Before being transformed into a blood slave, he was also the head of the Chen family in Chixia County, so his vision was naturally extraordinary.
Crystallization of spiritual power is a means of tempering spiritual power to the extreme.
Ordinary warriors simply can't do it, and even if they can do it, it will take a long time to accumulate strength.
But the other party was just talking and laughing.
This method does not look like that of a first-level warrior.
His face changed slightly, and he instinctively felt something was wrong.
"Wait..."
The moment he spokeSuddenly, a crystal thorn shot out quickly, creating a faint trace of light in the night.
The first blood slave shuddered, and was shot through the head in an instant, and his head exploded.
The Crystal Thorn continued unabated, killing the three blood slaves behind it one after another, and then stabbed into the courtyard wall.
[Kill the mortal blood slave and obtain the white entry [Bloodthirsty] × 4]
In an instant, a hole as thick as a forearm was pierced through the courtyard wall. Only then did the blood slaves react and retreat in horror.
Chen Lianshan's eyelids also jumped wildly.
He never expected that the crystal thorn would have such terrifying lethality.
If this continues...
Chen Lianshan subconsciously looked deep into the house. With just one glance, he seemed to have made some kind of decision in his heart.
"Don't think that I can't do anything to you just because you killed a few mortal blood slaves!"
He swallowed a bloody pill, and a strange bloody light suddenly burst out from his eyes.
Immediately afterwards, veins popped out all over his body, and his bones made crackling sounds.
The violent bloody aura hit his face, mixed with violence and murderous intent.
"You think you won?"
Chen Lianshan smiled ferociously, an astonishing light of blood filled his body, and his aura instantly surged to the original level.
He reached out and grabbed his back, and a blood-red bone knife was pulled out from his back and struck Lu Yuan with a scream that ripped through the air.
The surrounding blood slaves seemed to be inspired, their eyes turned blood red, and they attacked like evil spirits.
Lu Yuan's eyes flashed with golden light, and the sword moves that were as fast as lightning in Wu Shouxin's eyes suddenly slowed down.
The moment the blade fell, his foot stumbled slightly, and the blood-red blade struck his shoulder and split into the air, not even damaging a single hair.
Lu Yuan waved his hand, and the three-foot crystal thorn shot out quickly.
The crystal thorn was like a spear, instantly piercing Chen Lianshan's chest, exploding a deep pit on the ground and pinning him in it.
Chen Lianshan coughed up a mouthful of blood, his limbs twitched a few times, and became completely motionless.
The smoke cleared.
Wu Shouxin in the corner moved his Adam's apple with difficulty, horrified.
After taking the blood pill, Chen Lianshan's cultivation level skyrocketed to the initial level!
Was it solved like this?
In the three years he has been on the roster, he has seen the Demon-Suppressing Captain fight more than once, but no one has ever been as powerful as Lu Yuan.
Is this killing a demon?
It feels like killing a chicken but a dog.
The blood slaves around him were trembling, and their original murderous intent turned into deep fear in an instant.
Chen Lianshan is the leader of the blood slaves, and he also took the blood pill given by the blood demon. His cultivation level is close to the late stage of the first level, but he can't even survive a single move?
How to fight this?
The few blood slaves standing at the front were completely frightened, their legs were weak, and they didn't even dare to run.
"Haha...hahaha..." A sinister laughter suddenly sounded.
In the deep pit, Chen Lianshan, whose chest was pierced by crystal, suddenly raised his head, revealing a pair of blood-red eyes.
"Spiritual power crystallized, the lethality is really amazing!"
"But if you consume your spiritual power so violently, even a first-level warrior wouldn't be able to hold on for long, right?"
